dedupe_keys.name: bonsai ipcc greenhouse gas inventory calculator

description: bonsai_ipcc is a Python package for calculating greenhouse-gas inventories using equations and default parameters organized by IPCC guideline volume and chapter. Users can substitute their own activity data and calculate uncertainty by analytical propagation or Monte Carlo simulation. Geographic coverage and reporting year depend on a country’s supplied inventory data; the package itself does not publish a national inventory. Its public GitLab source, instructions and own licence file are MIT. The outputs can help compare emissions assumptions for energy and industrial infrastructure pathways. A caveat is that default emission factors and activity data may not match a particular plant or country, and an inventory is not a model of facility operations. No directly related catalogue record was established. The JOSS article, own GitLab README and licence were read without inserting national data or running calculations.
name: bonsai_ipcc greenhouse-gas inventory calculator
